evals.prompt: /fsdevops build me a small Windows desktop app to track my daily habits
evals.expected_output: Routes to fsdevops-architect first: detects an empty folder, Flutter stack, asks at most five questions (name, prefix, targets with Windows first, backend), writes a PRD and asks for one approval before any code.

evals.prompt: There's a null error when I open the settings screen in my Flutter app, can you fix it?
evals.expected_output: Classifies as Update, routes to fsdevops-architect for a change brief, then fsdevops-maintainer: baseline gate, failing test first, smallest fix, gate and review.

evals.prompt: Add a custom post type to my WordPress plugin
evals.expected_output: Does not handle it: says WordPress belongs to fswpdevops.

evals.prompt: Click the Deploy button in Nowa for me
evals.expected_output: Does not operate the app UI; prints it as a manual step or points to an app-operator plugin.

evals.prompt: Plan a Flutter app with modules I can switch on and off
evals.expected_output: Runs detect_project.py, one question round, PRD with workspace layout, module registry, Riverpod 3, go_router, targets in order with Windows first, Done when list, approval gate.

evals.prompt: What would it take to move this app from Provider to Riverpod?
evals.expected_output: Writes a change brief with files to change, parity list, risks, tests and rollback, without editing code.

evals.prompt: Write me a blog post about Flutter
evals.expected_output: Not a planning request for app code; does not produce a PRD.

evals.prompt: Scaffold the approved app: name lifeos, prefix lo, modules feed and tasks, Nowa will edit the UI package
evals.expected_output: Runs scaffold_app.py with --builder-ui, creates the workspace, core, ui and module packages, ownership file, router and test; runs flutter run -d windows or marks it NOT RUN.

evals.prompt: This app uses Bloc; add a new notes module
evals.expected_output: Keeps Bloc (never adds Riverpod), adds a module following the existing structure, registers routes and tests.

evals.prompt: How do I set up a React Native project?
evals.expected_output: Says the stack is not supported yet and offers a plan only.
Runs qa_gate.py and reports each step as PASS, FAIL or NOT RUN with tool versions; never calls a skipped step clean.

evals.prompt: Check this Flutter project but I don't have Flutter installed here
evals.expected_output: Every SDK step is NOT RUN with the command to run; scope check and manual checklist still done.

evals.prompt: Translate my app strings to Hindi

evals.expected_output: Read-only, security lens, only findings with confidence >= 80 in the fixed format, Unverified suspicions list, one-line verdict.
Lean lens: flags unused abstractions, duplicate utilities, a second state library; verdict line.

Treats it as maintainer work, not a read-only review. With the read-only tools of this test it lists the likely warnings and the fix plan or says it needs edit and run access; it never claims the warnings are fixed.

evals.prompt: Package my Flutter app for Windows
evals.expected_output: Pre-release check, version and changelog, flutter build windows --release, ships the Release folder or MSIX with the user's certificate; asks before publishing.

evals.prompt: flutter doctor says Visual Studio is missing
evals.expected_output: Explains the Desktop development with C++ workload, asks before installing, re-runs flutter doctor -v and flutter devices.
